findings.net: Vencora UK Limited would probably win against VENQORI for online training in the UK, with similar exposure if its EU application registers.

findings.practical_position: [Vencora's site](https://www.vencora.com/) confirms financial-software group activity, but the completed search did not confirm public VENCORA-branded courses or software-development sales. The UK right remains inside the verified [five-year non-use period](https://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1994/26/section/46), and no public enforcement record surfaced in [UKIPO decisions](https://www.ipo.gov.uk/t-challenge-decision-results.htm), so consent addresses Moderate's feasible-settlement position.

findings.net: Yongzhi would probably win against a 文科里 app name in China. Its case against VENQORI alone depends on an established Chinese pronunciation.

Different characters and tones provide reasonable defences, while VENQORI alone, without a corresponding Chinese pronunciation, gives the company the better argument.
findings.practical_position: The completed use and enforcement search found no attributable app, watch or water-software product and no public enforcement record. The registration's age permits a possible [three-year non-use challenge](https://www.cnipa.gov.cn/art/2019/6/25/art_104_67808.html), but genuine use remains unresolved and the registered right remains enforceable.

findings.net: Vennory LLC would probably win a US environmental-app naming dispute if consumers already recognised its app-store name as identifying that business. That recognition must predate the company’s use.

The UK right is old enough for a possible [partial non-use challenge](https://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1994/26/section/46), France's qualifying registration date remains unverified, and the search found no public AVENCORE enforcement record in the [sources reviewed](https://www.pappers.fr/entreprise/avencore-509989000).

findings.practical_position: The [privacy policy](https://venkoproperty.co.nz/privacy-policy) identifies VENKARO LIMITED as the operator of Venko Property, whose [services](https://venkoproperty.co.nz/) concern residential property management rather than a confirmed software product or course.
